blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Given the enormous number of claims to be checked, verifiable legal AI requires scalable, cost-effective models that answer the practical needs of law. System One decision models are built on large language models but, instead of generating text, return a calibrated probability for each option. This suits the verification of legal authority, where the question is closed: a given holding, or none of them. We test whether such models abstain when the correct authority is missing. We extend CaseHOLD with an abstention condition in which the correct holding is replaced in 1,670 of 5,314 items, and compare four decision models with six generative LLMs. When no option is correct, generative LLMs still pick one in 38-86% of items; the most cautious decision model does so in 30%. On standard CaseHOLD, a decision model matches the best generative LLM (88.1% vs. 88.2%) at 1/55 of the cost. Accepting that LLM's answer only when a decision model agrees halves its wrong citations, and distilling a decision model's probabilities into Qwen3-8B, without labels, yields a well-calibrated local model. Legal AI should be judged by its wrong citations, not by accuracy alone.
blocks.zh: 鉴于需要核实的索赔数量之多,可核查的法律大赦国际需要适应法律实际需要的可扩展、成本效益高的模式。 系统 一个决定模型建立在大语言模型上,但是不生成文本,而是返回每个选项的校准概率. 这符合对法律权威的核查,因为问题已经解决:一个特定持有,或一个都没有。 我们检验这些模型是否在缺乏正确权威时弃权。 我们延长了CaseHOLD的弃权条件,即在5 314项中的1 670项中替换正确的持有量,并将4项决定模型与6项基因有限责任清单进行比较。 当没有选择正确时,遗传性LLMs仍然在38-86%的项目中选择一个;最谨慎的决定模式是30%。 在标准CaseHOLD中,一个决定模型与成本的1/55的最佳基因LLM(88.1%对88.2%)相匹配。 接受LLM的答案,只有在一个决定模型同意将错误的引用量减半时,才能接受,并且将一个决定模型的概率分馏为Qune3-8B,没有标签,产生一个精准的本地模型. 应以错误的引用,而不是仅以准确性来判断法警。

blocks.en: Language models are now used across legal practice, and most visibly in legal research. Law has also become one of the best-documented domains of their failure. Since late 2022, courts have sanctioned lawyers and pro se litigants for filings that cite authorities that do not exist or do not support the propositions they are cited for ( Mata, 2023 ; Billups, 2025 ) . Each such filing adds work to an already overburdened court system. Someone has to check the citations, and courts must then hold hearings and decide on sanctions. The problem now reaches the bench, with judges’ own orders among the documented cases ( Charlotin, 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 语言模型现在用于各种法律实践,最明显的是用于法律研究。 法律也成为其失败的最佳记录领域之一。 自2022年末以来,法院已经对律师和亲诉讼当事人的起诉进行了制裁,这些起诉引用了不存在的或不支持所援引主张的当局(Mata,2023年;Billups,2025年)。 每次此类备案都为本已负担过重的法院系统增加了工作。 有人必须检查引用情况,然后法院必须举行听证和决定制裁。 问题现在已落到法官席上,

blocks.en: The problem is not limited to general-purpose chatbots. In a preregistered evaluation, commercial legal research tools built on retrieval-augmented generation, some marketed as hallucination-free, still hallucinated on 17% to 33% of queries ( Magesh et al., 2025 ) ; general-purpose models did so at least 58% of the time ( Dahl et al., 2024 ) . Courts now see the same failure in practice. In October 2026, a federal court reviewed filings whose author admitted taking propositions from a Westlaw AI tool without confirming them ( Mercante, 2026 ) . Nor is the problem fading with newer models. Across eight generations of ChatGPT models, citation hallucination rates did not consistently decline, and GPT-5.1 produced hallucinated citations more often than the best mid-2024 GPT-4o release ( Liu et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 问题不仅限于通用聊天器. 在一项预先登记的评价中,商业法律研究工具建立在检索增强的一代之上,一些工具作为无幻觉的市场,在17%至33%的查询中仍然产生幻觉(Magesh等人,2025年);通用模型至少58%的时间这样做(Dahl等人,2024年)。 法院现在实际上也看到了同样的失败。 2026年10月,一个联邦法院审查了其提交人承认接受Westlaw AI工具的命案,但没有予以确认(Mercante, 2026年)。 问题也没有随着新的模式而消失。 在八代的ChatGPT模型中,引用的幻觉率并没有持续下降,GPT-5.1产生的幻觉引证比最佳的2024年中GPT-4o释放(Liu等人,2026年)更频繁.

blocks.en: Institutions are responding. California requires its courts to adopt generative-AI use policies that address hallucinated output ( Judicial Council of California, 2025 ) , and the State Bar of California has proposed amending its rule on candor to the tribunal so that lawyers must verify that cited authorities exist and are accurate ( State Bar of California, 2026 ) . Texas has proposed that signers of filings represent that their citations, quotations, and holdings are not fabricated ( Supreme Court of Texas, 2026 ) . Appellate courts now sanction unverified citations with fees, fines, and referrals to the bar ( Noland, 2025 ; Whiting, 2026 ) . Yet the cases keep growing, and one public tracker lists 2,203 court matters involving AI hallucinations, 1,264 of them from 2026 alone ( Charlotin, 2026 ) . Fabrication is only part of the problem. In 933 of these matters, a real authority was cited for a proposition it does not support ( Charlotin, 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 各机构正在作出反应。 加利福尼亚州要求其法院采用处理幻觉产出的基因-AI政策(加利福尼亚州司法委员会,2025年),加利福尼亚州律师协会向法庭提议修改其关于坦率的规则,以便律师必须核实所引用的当局的存在和准确性(加利福尼亚州律师协会,2026年)。 德克萨斯州提议,提交文件的签字人表示,他们的引用、引文和持有不是捏造的(德克萨斯州最高法院,2026年)。 上诉法院现在对未经核实的引用予以处罚,包括收费、罚款和移交律师(Noland,2025年;Whiting,2026年)。 包括AI幻觉, 其中1,264件发生在2026年(Charlotin, 2026年)。 制造只是问题的一部分。 在其中933年,一个不支持的主张(Charlotin,2026年)被援引为真正的权威。

blocks.en:
Technical responses mostly add more language-model machinery: retrieval augmentation, better training data, model editing, decoding strategies ( Huang et al., 2025 ) , and agentic verification.
These efforts work against a structural pressure. Kalai et al. (2025) trace hallucinations to a simple classification problem, deciding whether a statement is valid. Models make errors on this problem, and the errors persist because training and evaluation reward guessing. Under accuracy-style scoring, a model that always guesses scores higher than one that admits it is unsure. In legal writing, the guess is the costly outcome, a confident citation to the wrong authority. Legal studies observe the same tendency. When told to stop if no factual basis existed, most models produced arguments anyway ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh:
技术答复大多增加了更多的语言模型机制:检索增强、更好的培训数据、模型编辑、解码战略(黄等人,2025年)和代理核查。
这些努力在结构压力下起作用。 Kalai等人(2025年)将幻觉追踪到一个简单的分类问题,决定一个陈述是否有效. 模型在这个问题上会出错,错误依然存在,因为培训和评价会奖励猜测。 在精度风格的评分下,一个总是猜测分数高于承认分数的模型是不确定的. 在法律写作中,猜测是代价高昂的结果,自信地引用错误的权威. 法律研究也观察到同样的趋势。 多数模型都提出了论据(Zhang等人,2025年)。

blocks.en: Most evaluations ask whether a model picks the right authority from a set of candidates, but in practice the right authority is often not among them. A useful system should then say so rather than choose the closest option. We therefore ask whether a model, when the correct authority is missing, commits to a wrong one or abstains. The two errors are not equally costly. A wrong commitment can reach a filing; an unnecessary abstention costs a lawyer an extra lookup. Accuracy treats them the same. What matters instead is whether a model’s confidence can tell a user which answers to check.
blocks.zh: 多数评价都问一个模式是否从一组候选人中选择了正确的权威,但实际上,正确的权威往往不在其中. 然后,一个有用的系统应该这样说,而不是选择最接近的选择。 因此,我们问,当没有正确权威时,一个模式是否犯下错误,还是弃权。 这两个错误并非同样昂贵。 错误的承诺可以提交备案;不必要的弃权使律师需要额外寻找。 准确性对待他们一样。 相反,重要的是模型的信心能否告诉一个用户谁回答检查。

blocks.en: Legal NLP posed many of these problems as classification well before large language models. CaseHOLD asks which of five holdings a court gave for a cited case ( Zheng et al., 2021 ) ; ContractNLI asks whether a contract entails, contradicts, or does not mention a hypothesis ( Koreeda and Manning, 2021 ) ; MAUD poses expert questions about merger agreements ( Wang et al., 2023 ) . These tasks were addressed with fine-tuned encoders. Since large language models arrived, the same tasks are mostly posed to general-purpose generative models.
blocks.zh: 法律NLP在大型语言模型之前就已经提出了许多这类问题。 CaseHOLD询问,法院为所引用的案件(郑等人,2021年)提供了5种控股中的哪一种(Zheng等人,2021年);ContractNLI询问一项合同是否包含、抵触或没有提到一种假设(Koreeda和Manning,2021年);MAUD对合并协议提出了专家问题(Wang等人,2023年)。 这些任务用微调编码器处理。 由于大型语言模型的到来,同样的任务大多是针对通用基因模型的.

blocks.en: The underlying need has not changed. Lawyers and courts need to check, at scale, whether a specific authority supports a specific proposition, and to be told when it does not. This calls for precision and calibrated confidence more than open-ended reasoning. A verification model should decide only when the evidence is sufficient ( Atanasova et al., 2022 ) , and small models trained for a narrow verification task can match GPT-4 at a fraction of its cost ( Tang et al., 2024 ) . If more reasoning alone solved the problem, the strongest models would not continue to hallucinate ( Liu et al., 2026 ) . In legal case-based reasoning, reasoning models even spend more computation on wrong answers than on right ones ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) .
blocks.zh: 基本需要没有改变。 律师和法院需要从规模上检查某一具体当局是否支持某项具体提议,并在不支持时被告知。 这需要精确和校准的信心,而不是无限制的推理。 核查模型只有在证据充分时才能决定(Atanasova等人,2022年),为狭义核查任务而培训的小型模型可与其成本的一小部分相匹配(Tang等人,2024年)。 如果更多的推理单独解决问题,最强模型就不会继续产生幻觉(Liu等人,2026年). 在基于法律案例的推理中,推理模型甚至花费更多的时间来计算错误答案而不是正确答案(张等人,2026b ).

blocks.en: System One decision models revisit the classification framing with modern models. TypeSafe released the first of them, Jev, in September 2026 ( TypeSafe, 2026a ) . The name follows the fast, intuitive System 1 of Kahneman (2011) , and commentators soon began calling them decision models ( Willison, 2026 ) . They are themselves built on large language models, but instead of generating text they return a typed decision and a probability for each option. By late September, an analysis of GitHub found 2,170 public projects using Jev ( Ling et al., 2026 ) , and a community index now tracks more than 170 decision models from many developers ( multimodalart and contributors, 2026 ) . This design fits the task of checking an authority well. The question is closed (this holding, or none of them), so there is nothing to write, and the probability states how sure the model is, which is what a user needs in order to decide what to check. TypeSafe trains its Jev model with reinforcement learning for calibrated decisions (RLCD), which optimizes these probabilities against outcomes rather than human preferences ( TypeSafe, 2026b ) . Whether such models are more trustworthy than generative LLMs where it matters most in law, when the right authority is not available, has not been tested.
blocks.zh: 系统 一个决策模型重新审视了与现代模型的分类框架。 TypeSafe于2026年9月发行了其中第一台Jev(TypeSafe,2026a). 名称沿用了Kahneman (2011)的快速,直观系统1,评论家很快开始称他们为决策模型(Willison, 2026). 它们本身建立在大型语言模型之上,但并没有生成文本,而是返回一个打字决定和每个选项的概率. 到9月下旬,对GitHub的分析发现有2,170个公共项目使用Jev(Ling等人,2026年),一个社区指数现在追踪了来自许多开发商(多式联运和贡献者,2026年)的170多个决策模型. 这种设计符合检查当局的任务。 问题已经解决了(这个持有,或者没有它们),所以没有什么可以写,概率说明模型的确定性如何,这就是用户为了决定检查什么而需要的. TypeSafe训练其Jev模型,为校准决定进行强化学习(RLCD),它根据结果而不是人类偏好优化了这些概率(TypeSafe,2026b). 这种模型是否比在法律上最重要的遗传性有限责任公司更值得信赖,当没有适当的权威时,还没有经过测试。

blocks.en: We examine this with CaseHOLD. We add a condition in which the correct holding is sometimes replaced by a similar holding from another case, and a sixth option states that none of the holdings applies. We compare four System One decision models with six generative LLMs on all 5,314 test items. We ask how often each model commits to a holding when none is correct, what its caution costs, and whether the two kinds of model can cover for each other.
blocks.zh: 我们用CaseHOLD来检查这个 我们增加了一个条件,即有时正确的持有权被另一个案例的类似持有权所取代,第六个备选办法是,所有持有权都不适用。 我们比较了所有5 314个测试项目的4个系统1决定模型和6个基因有限责任模型。 我们问,当没有一种模式不正确时,每种模式都承诺多少次坚持,其谨慎的代价如何,两种模式能否相互覆盖。

blocks.en: Our contributions are: • A test of abstention for legal authority. We extend CaseHOLD so that in 1,670 of its 5,314 test items the correct holding is replaced by a similar holding from another case, and measure how often a model cites a holding when none applies (Figure 1 a). • A comparison across model types and prices. We evaluate four System One decision models and six generative LLMs from five vendors, reporting accuracy, calibration, abstention, and cost (Figure 1 b). • A cost-aware view of combining them. We show how pairing a System One model with a generative LLM trades wrong citations against items sent for human review, and frame the choice of operating point by the unequal cost of the two errors. • Local deployment and checks on what the results mean. Trained only on a System One model’s probabilities, with no labeled data, a local Qwen3-8B model learns to answer and abstain like its teacher and becomes well calibrated. Contamination tests extending Arvin (2025) show that models know much of the case law but do not depend on it.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献是: 我们扩展了CaseHOLD,以便在其5,314个测试项目中的1,670个中,正确的持有量被另一个案例的类似持有量所取代,并衡量模型在不适用的情况下引用持有量的频率(图1a)。 • 模型类型和价格的比较。 我们评价5个供应商的4个系统1决策模型和6个基因有限责任公司,报告准确性、校准、弃权和成本(图1b)。 · 具有成本意识的合并观点。 我们展示一个系统一模型与基因LLM的配对方式, 将错误的引用与发送到人类审查的物品进行交易, • 当地部署和检查结果的含义。 一个本地的Qwen3-8B模型只接受过System One模型的概率训练,没有标注数据,学习像它的老师一样回答和弃权,并变得精准. 延伸的阿尔文(2025年)污染测试显示模型知道许多案例法,但并不依赖于它.

blocks.en: 2. Related Work
blocks.zh: 2. 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1. Legal Datasets with Verifiable Answers
blocks.zh: 2.1. 附有可核实答复的法律数据集

blocks.en: Legal NLP has a long line of datasets whose answers can be checked against a source. Many of them come from contracts. ContractNLI asks whether a contract entails, contradicts, or says nothing about a hypothesis ( Koreeda and Manning, 2021 ) , CUAD marks the clauses lawyers look for in contract review ( Hendrycks et al., 2021 ) , and MAUD asks expert questions about merger agreements ( Wang et al., 2023 ) . COLIEE has run shared tasks on retrieving and entailing statutes and case law for years ( Goebel et al., 2024 ) . In CaseHOLD, the dataset we use, a model picks which of five holdings a court gave for a cited case ( Zheng et al., 2021 ) ; Section 3 describes it in detail. LexGLUE ( Chalkidis et al., 2022 ) and LegalBench ( Guha et al., 2023 ) later gathered tasks like these into suites for evaluating language models, and LawBench did the same for Chinese law ( Fei et al., 2024 ) . In almost all of them, the correct answer is among the candidates and every error counts the same. Neither is true when a lawyer checks a citation.
blocks.zh: 法律NLP有很长的一行数据集,其答案可以对照一个来源来检查. 其中许多来自合同。 ContractNLI询问一项合同是否包含、抵触或对一项假设一言不发(Koreeda and Manning, 2021年), CUAD标注了律师在合同审查中寻找的条款(Hendrycks等人, 2021年), MAUD询问有关合并协议的专家问题(Wang等人, 2023年)。 COLIEE多年来共同承担着检索和制定法规和判例法的任务(Goebel等人,2024年)。 在CaseHOLD中,我们使用的数据集是一个模型选择,法院为一个被引用的案件提供了5种财产(郑等人,2021年);第3节对此作了详细描述。 LexGLUE(Chalkidis等人,2022年)和Legal Bench(Guha等人,2023年)后来将这样的任务收集到用于评价语言模型的套房中,Law Bench对中国法律也做了同样的事情(Fei等人,2024年). 在几乎所有国家中,正确的答案都是在候选人中,每一个错误都算得一样。 当律师检查引用时,情况也一样。

blocks.en: 2.2. Abstention and Unanswerable Questions
blocks.zh: 2.2. 回避和无法回答的问题

blocks.en: Outside law, SQuAD 2.0 added questions that look answerable but are not, so that a system had to learn when to stay silent ( Rajpurkar et al., 2018 ) . Later work asked the same of language models with multiple-choice questions. Models lose much of their accuracy when none of the above is the right option ( Tam et al., 2025 ) , and they keep choosing an option even when every option is wrong ( Góral et al., 2025 ) . Across twenty datasets, AbstentionBench even finds that reasoning fine-tuning can make abstention worse ( Kirichenko et al., 2025 ) . Kalai et al. (2025) argue that this follows from how models are graded, since a guess is rewarded over an admission of uncertainty. Our abstain condition brings this test to legal authority, where a confident guess becomes a citation to the wrong holding.
blocks.zh: 在法律之外,SQuAD 2.0添加了看起来有答案但又不是的问题,因此系统必须学会何时保持沉默(Rajpurkar等人,2018年). 后来的作品用多个选择题问语言模型相同. 当上述任何一种选择都不是正确选择(Tam等人,2025年)时,模型就会失去很多准确性(Góral等人,2025年),即使每个选择都是错误的,它们也会继续选择一个选择(Góral等人,2025年). 在20个数据集中,弃权奔驰甚至发现推理微调会使弃权更糟糕(Kirichenko等人,2025年)。 Kalai等人(2025年)认为,这是从模型的分级方式得出的,因为猜测是对承认不确定性的奖励。 我们的弃权条件给法律权威带来了这个考验,在那里,自信的猜测成为对错误持有的引用.

blocks.en: 2.3. System One Decision Models
blocks.zh: 2.3. 一个系统的决定模式

blocks.en: System One models answer typed questions with a probability for each option instead of generated text ( TypeSafe, 2026b ) . Jev, the first of them, is trained with RLCD, and its architecture and training remain proprietary. Adoption has been fast. An analysis of 2,170 public projects finds Jev used mainly for judging attributes and scoring, as a component inside larger workflows ( Ling et al., 2026 ) . A community index now tracks more than 170 decision models from many developers ( multimodalart and contributors, 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 系统 一个模型以每个选项的概率回答打出的问题,而不是生成文本(TypeSafe, 2026b ). 其中第一位Jev接受了RLCD的训练,其建筑和训练仍为专有. 收养速度很快。 对2,170个公共项目的分析发现,Jev主要用于判断属性和评分,作为更大的工作流程中的一个组成部分(Ling等人,2026年). 一个社区指数现在跟踪来自许多开发商的170多个决策模型(多式联运和贡献者,2026年).

blocks.en: Open work has taken two routes to the same behavior. One trains for it directly, implementing Jev’s objective with strictly proper scoring rules ( Gao and Wang, 2026 ) . The other reads it out of existing language models, whose next-token probabilities over the option letters already behave as a decision model, and light fine-tuning closes most of the remaining gap ( Geuter et al., 2026 ; Li and Wagle, 2026 ) . A third recipe distills a model’s own post-reasoning answer into a single-pass readout ( Duan et al., 2026 ) . Open-weight models such as Laya, a 421M-parameter encoder, now exist alongside Jev ( Nandakishore, 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 公开工作已经走两条路线 达到同样的行为。 一列列车直接为它服务,执行捷夫的目标,严格按适当的评分规则(Gao and Wang, 2026). 另一种则从现有语言模型中读出,其邻接选项字母的概率已经表现为决定模型,光线微调可以缩小大部分剩余空白(Geuter等人,2026年;Li和Wagle,2026年). 第三个食谱将模型本身的推理后答案提炼成单通读数(Duan等人,2026年)。 例如Laya, 421M参数编码器,

blocks.en: Independent evaluations have appeared only in recent weeks. Jev is competitive with frontier generative LLMs on knowledge and commonsense benchmarks but falls behind on multi-step arithmetic ( Li et al., 2026 ; Deußer et al., 2026 ) . Decision models do best when the answer can be resolved from the evidence given, but often overstate the probability of their most likely answer ( Duan et al., 2026 ) , and their calibration shifts with the wording of a question ( Sharma et al., 2026 ) . Two studies bear directly on abstention. In medical question answering, most evaluated models struggle to recognize when the correct answer is missing ( Du et al., 2026 ) . Jev’s confidence can also stay high when no answer-relevant information is given at all ( Shankaranarayana et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 最近几周才出现独立评价。 Jev在知识和常识基准方面与前沿遗传性LLMs具有竞争力,但在多步骤算术方面落后(Li等人,2026年;Deußer等人,2026年)。 当从提供的证据中解答问题时,决策模型做得最好,但往往过度说明其最可能解答的概率(Duan等人,2026年),而且其校准随问题的措辞而变化(Sharma等人,2026年)。 两项研究直接涉及弃权。 在医学问题回答中,大多数被评价的模型都难以识别何时没有正确答案(Du等人,2026年). Jev的信心也可以保持高水平,

blocks.en: Decision models are also combined with other models. They serve as gates in front of generative LLMs ( Li, 2026 ) , and escalating their uncertain cases to a generative LLM can match the larger model’s accuracy at close to the decision model’s cost ( Rafe and Das, 2026 ) , in the line of earlier cascades and routers ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Ong et al., 2025 ) . Jev’s judgments have also been distilled into small task-specific evaluators for chess and passage reranking ( Sadoun et al., 2026 ) , though not, to our knowledge, into a general-purpose generative LLM.
blocks.zh: 决策模式也与其他模式相结合。 它们作为基因LLMs(Li, 2026年)前的大门, 并将其不确定的病例升级为基因LLM, 可以在接近决定模型成本(Rafe and Das, 2026年)的情况下, 在早期的级联和路由器(Chen等人, 2024年;Ong等人, 2025年)的线路中, 匹配更大的模型的精度. Jev的判断也被提炼成针对特定任务的小型国际象棋评测员和重新排名的棋子(Sadoun等人,2026年),但据我们所知,并没有被提炼成通用基因LLM.

blocks.en: In law, Zhang et al. (2026a) compare Jev with nine generative LLMs on ContractNLI and find it the cheapest and fastest, though less accurate than hosted models. No prior work evaluates decision models on choosing legal authority, or combines them with generative LLMs to limit wrong citations.
blocks.zh: 在法律上,张等人(2026a)将Jev与ContractNLI上的9个基因性LLMs进行比较,发现它是最便宜和最快的,虽然不如主机模型准确. 先前没有一项工作评价关于选择法律权威的决定模式,或将它们与遗传性有限责任公司合并,以限制错误引用。

blocks.en: 3. Method
blocks.zh: 3个 方法

blocks.en: 3.1. Task and Data
blocks.zh: 3.1. 任务和数据

blocks.en: CaseHOLD is built from U.S. court opinions in the Harvard Law Library case law corpus ( Zheng et al., 2021 ) . Courts often follow a citation with a parenthetical stating the cited case’s holding, for example (holding that consideration exists where a customer must visit the store) . CaseHOLD replaces this parenthetical with the token <HOLDING>. Each item consists of a short excerpt from the citing opinion and five candidate holdings. One is the holding the court wrote, and the other four are holdings from other citations with the most similar wording. We use the full test split of 5,314 items.
blocks.zh: CaseHOLD是根据美国法院在哈佛法律图书馆判例法(郑等人,2021年)中的意见建立的。 例如,法院往往遵循引文,括号内写明所引述案件的持有情况(认为在客户必须到店里去时有考虑)。 CaseHOLD 用符号<HOLDING> 代替此括号 。 每个项目包括引证意见的简短节录和5个候选控股。 一个是法庭所写的控股,其他四个是其他引文中措辞最相似的控股。 我们使用5,314件物品的全测试分数。

blocks.en: 3.2. Two Conditions
blocks.zh: 3.2. 两个条件

blocks.en: The original condition is CaseHOLD as published, with five options and one correct answer.
blocks.zh: 原始条件为已公布的CaseHOLD,有五个选项和一个正确的答案.

blocks.en: The abstain condition adds a sixth option, None of the listed holdings is the one the cited case is being cited for in this passage . In a random 31% of items (1,670), the correct holding is replaced by another real holding, and the sixth option becomes the correct answer. The replacement is selected with CaseHOLD’s procedure for wrong options. It is the holding from another test item with the highest TF-IDF cosine similarity to the removed holding, subject to CaseHOLD’s similarity cap of 0.75. Replacements have a mean similarity of 0.28 to the removed holding, compared with 0.30 for CaseHOLD’s own wrong options. In the remaining 3,644 items the correct holding is kept, and the sixth option is wrong.
blocks.zh: 投弃权票的条件增加了第六个选项,所列所有财产都不是本段所引述的案例。 在随机31%的项目(1,670)中,正确的持有被另一个真正的持有所取代,第六个选项成为正确的答案. CaseHOLD 程序选择替换错误选项。 这是另一个试验品的持有量,其TF-IDF同位素相似度最高,与被移除的持有量相同,但CaseHOLD的相似性上限为0.75。 替代物与取消的持有物有0.28的中等相似性,而CaseHOLD自己的错误选择为0.30。 在其余的3 644件物品中,保留正确的持有量,第六个选项是错误的。

blocks.en: 3.3. Models

We compare two kinds of model, both built on large language models, that differ in their output (Table 1 ). System One decision models receive the passage as state and a single choice question whose options are the holdings, and they return a probability for each option. We evaluate Jev ( TypeSafe, 2026b ) , Perplexity’s pplx-decider, Liquid AI’s d1-ultra, and OpenAI’s GPT-6 Luna Decisions through OpenRouter’s decisions interface. Generative LLMs receive the same instruction, passage, and options as a chat message and return the key of one option. The six generative LLMs come from five vendors and cover a range of prices. They include GPT-4o-mini, which Arvin (2025) evaluated on CaseHOLD, and GLM 5.3 Flash, whose price per question is close to Jev’s.
blocks.zh: 我们比较两种模型,两种模型都是建立在大语言模型之上的,它们的输出不同(表1). 系统 一个决策模型作为状态和单一选择问题收到,其选择是持有量,它们返回每种选择的概率。 我们评价Jev(TypeSafe, 2026b), Perplexity的pplx-decide, Liquid AI的d1-ultra,以及OpenAI的GPT-6 Luna决定通过OpenRouter的决定界面. Generative LLMs 作为聊天信息收到相同的指令,段落和选项,并返回一个选项的密钥. 这6种遗传性有限责任公司来自5家销售商,涵盖一系列价格。 包括GPT-4o-mini(Arvin(2025年)在CaseHOLD上评价)和GLM 5.3 Flash(每个问题的价格接近Jev).

blocks.en: Table 1. Models evaluated. Cost is the amount billed per 1,000 questions in the original condition; batch-processed models were billed at batch rates.
blocks.zh: 表1. 评价的模式。 成本是原始状态下每1000个问题计费的金额;分批处理的模型按分批收费.

blocks.en: 3.4. Prompts and Settings
blocks.zh: 3.4. 提示和设置

blocks.en: All models receive the same one-sentence instruction, which states that a court opinion cites a case, that the parenthetical describing its holding has been replaced by <HOLDING>, and that the task is to identify the holding the citing court gave. Decision models receive the passage as state and the holdings as the options of a choice question. Generative LLMs receive the passage and lettered options in one message and reply with a JSON object containing only the option key. This format is enforced with structured output, since some models otherwise produced an explanation first. Generative LLMs are not asked for a confidence score; Appendix B reports a pilot with stated confidence.
blocks.zh: 所有模式都收到同样的单一判决指示,该指示指出,法院意见引用一个案件,描述其持有的括号已被 " HOLDING " 所取代,任务是确定援引法院的持有情况。 决策模型作为状态和持有量作为选择问题的选项获得。 Generative LLMs 在一个消息中接收段落和字母选项,并使用只包含选项密钥的JSON对象进行回复. 这种格式以结构化的产出加以执行,因为有些模型在其他方面首先提出了解释。 基因有限责任公司不要求获得信心分数;附录B报告一个试点公司有明确的信心。

blocks.en: Generative LLMs run at temperature 0 with the lowest reasoning setting each model offers above none; GPT-4o-mini has no reasoning setting. We record reasoning tokens and the billed cost of every call. 1 1 1 One passage, from a criminal case, was refused by the content filter of Claude Haiku 5.5’s provider, so that model’s abstain-condition results cover 5,313 items. The full prompts are in Appendix A .
3.5. Metrics

We report accuracy and macro F1 in both conditions. In the abstain condition, two error rates are reported separately. The wrong-pick rate is the share of items without a correct holding in which the model picked a holding. The false-abstention rate is the share of items with a correct holding in which the model chose the none option. For decision models, we also report expected calibration error over ten bins and the AUROC of the none probability for separating items with and without a correct holding. Confidence intervals are 95% percentile bootstrap intervals with 2,000 resamples. Paired comparisons between models use exact McNemar tests on the same items.
blocks.zh: 我们在这两种条件下都报告准确性和宏观F1. 在弃权条件下,两个错误率分别报告。 误选率是没有正确控件的物品在模型中选择控件的比例. 假吸收率是模型选择无选项的正确控件的比例。 对于决定模型,我们还报告十箱的预期校准误差,以及无正确控件的分离概率的AUROC。 置信间隔为95%的靴子间隔,有2000个复印. 模型之间的Paired比较使用精确的麦克内马尔测试相同物品.

blocks.en: 3.6. Combining Decision Models and Generative LLMs
blocks.zh: 3.6. 将决策模式与遗传法学课程结合起来

blocks.en: We evaluate three policies that combine a decision model with a generative LLM, all on the abstain condition. In the veto policy, the generative LLM’s answer is accepted unless the decision model’s probability of none exceeds a threshold. In the agreement gate , an answer is accepted only when both models choose the same option, and other items are sent for review. This follows the observation that hard items tend to defeat some models but not others ( Demir and Canbaz, 2026 ) . In System One first , the decision model answers when its top probability exceeds a threshold, and the generative LLM is called only for the remaining items, which reduces cost.
blocks.zh: 我们评价三种政策,将决策模式与基因LLM相结合,都处于弃权状态。 在否决政策中,除非决定模式的概率不超过一个门槛,否则基因LLM的答案会被接受. 在协议门中,只有在两种模式选择相同的选项,其他项目被送去审查时,才接受答案. 这与硬项往往击败一些模型而不是其他模型(Demir and Canbaz, 2026)的观察有关. 在System One中,决定模型在最高概率超过阈值时回答,基因LLM只用于剩余项目,这降低了成本.

blocks.en: Each item ends as a correct answer, a wrong citation, or a review, meaning an item flagged for a person although the correct holding was present. We score a policy by k ⋅ wrong citations + reviews k\cdot\text{wrong citations}+\text{reviews} , where k k is the cost of a wrong citation relative to an unnecessary review. We know of no empirical estimate of k k for legal research. The values k = 1 , 5 , 10 k=1,5,10 are therefore illustrative, and Figure 4 shows the full trade-off. Thresholds are tuned on a random 30% of items, and results are reported on the remaining 70% (3,720 items).
blocks.zh: 每个项目作为正确的回答、错误的引用或审查结尾,意指为某人标注的项目,尽管有正确的控件。 我们通过 k 错误引用 + 重审 k\ cdot\ text{ 错误引用 { text{ 重审} 来评分一个政策, k k 相对于不必要的重审来说是错误引用的成本 。 我们知道没有关于kk进行法律研究的经验估计。 因此,K = 1、5、10k = 1、5、10的数值是说明性的,图4显示完全取舍。 阈值在30%的随机项目上调整,其余70%(3 720项)的结果报告。

blocks.en: 3.7. Contamination Checks
blocks.zh: 3.7. 污染检查

blocks.en: Since CaseHOLD is built from public opinions, a model may recognize a cited case instead of reasoning from the passage. Following Arvin (2025) , we test this with three variants of each passage, one with case names and citations anonymized, one showing only the cited case’s citation, and one with that citation removed. Appendix C describes the procedure and results.
blocks.zh: 由于CaseHOLD是根据公众意见建立起来的,一个模型可能承认一个引用的案例而不是从段落中推理. 在Arvin(2025年)之后,我们用每个段落的三个变体来测试,一个是案例名称和引用的匿名,一个是只显示被引用的案例的引用,另一个是删除引用的引用。 附 录 C描述了程序和结果。

blocks.en: 3.8. Distillation

We test whether a decision model’s probabilities can train a model that runs locally. Qwen3-8B is fine-tuned with LoRA on 10,000 items from CaseHOLD’s training split in the abstain condition. We compare three versions: the base model, a model trained only to match Jev’s probabilities, and a model trained on gold labels. The first two use no labeled data. Each model’s answer distribution is read from its next-token probabilities over the option letters ( Geuter et al., 2026 ; Li and Wagle, 2026 ) , so that its calibration can be measured in the same way as a decision model’s. Earlier work distilled Jev into task-specific evaluators ( Sadoun et al., 2026 ) ; here the student is a general-purpose generative LLM. Each version was trained once on a single NVIDIA RTX A6000 (48 GB). A training run took about 90 minutes, and evaluation on the full test split about 13 minutes. Training settings are in Appendix D .
blocks.zh: 我们来测试一个决定模型的概率是否能够训练一个在当地运行的模型。 Qune3-8B在CaseHOLD训练的10 000件物品上与LORA进行了微调, 我们比较了三个版本:基础模型,一个只接受过Jev概率测试的模型,以及一个接受过金牌测试的模型. 前两款使用无标签数据. 每个模型的答案分布从选择字母(Geuter等人,2026年;Li和Wagle,2026年)的下一位概率读取,以便其校准可以和决定模型一样进行测量. 早期的工作将Jev蒸馏成特定任务评价员(Sadoun等人,2026年);这里的学生是一个通用基因LLM. 每个版本在单NVIDIA RTX A6000(48 GB)上培训过一次. 一次训练跑大约需要90分钟,对全测试的评价则分约13分钟. 培训环境载于附录D。

blocks.en: 4.1. Accuracy and Cost
blocks.zh: 4.1. 准确性和成本

blocks.en: On the original task, the best decision model and the best generative LLM are tied. pplx-decider reaches 88.1% and Gemini 3.8 Flash 88.2% (difference − 0.2 -0.2 points, 95% CI [ − 1.2 , 0.8 ] [-1.2,0.8] , p = 0.74 p=0.74 ), at about 1/55 of the cost (Table 2 ). Macro F1 tracks accuracy within 0.002 for every model. All models lose accuracy in the abstain condition, by 9.9 to 18.7 points.

Macro F1 Track精度在0.002范围内,每款模型. 所有模型在弃置条件中都失去了精度,比9.9比18.7分.

blocks.en: 4.2. Committing When No Holding Is Correct
blocks.zh: 4.2. 在不持有正确时提交

blocks.en: When the correct holding is missing, most models still pick one (Figure 1 ). Among generative LLMs, the wrong-pick rate ranges from 37.8% for Gemini 3.8 Flash to 85.6% for GPT-4o-mini, the model Arvin (2025) evaluated on CaseHOLD. Among decision models, it ranges from 30.1% for Jev to 60.8% for GPT-6 Luna Decisions. blocks.en: 4.3. Combining Decision Models and Generative LLMs
blocks.zh: 4.3. 将决策模式与基因有限责任公司结合起来

blocks.en: Combining the two kinds of model lowers wrong citations, but sends more items to a person for review (Figure 4 ). The veto and System One first policies need a threshold, which we chose on a random 30% of items (Section 3 ). To keep that choice from flattering the results, every number in this section comes from the remaining 70% (3,720 items), which played no part in choosing it.
blocks.zh: 将两种模式组合起来会降低引用错误,但会将更多的项目发送给一个人进行审查(图4 )。 否决权和第一系统政策需要一个门槛,我们随机选择30%的项目(第3节)。 为使这一选择不夸大结果,本节的每个数字都来自其余的70%(3 720项),而这部分没有参与选择。

blocks.en: Take Gemini 3.8 Flash as an example. Alone, it cites a wrong holding on 18.4% of items. With the agreement gate, we accept Gemini’s answer only when pplx-decider gives the same answer. This cuts wrong citations by half, to 9.4%. The price is review: 12.7% of items now go to a person even though the correct holding was there, against 3.0% for Gemini alone. The share of correct answers barely changes (78.0% against 78.5%), and the extra cost is about 1%.
blocks.zh: 以双子座 3.8 Flash为例. 单独地,它引用了对18.4%的物品的错误持有。 我们只接受双子座的答案, 这把错误引用减少了一半,达到9.4%。 价格审查:12.7%的物品现在交给一个人,尽管正确的持有量已经存在,而单是双子座就只有3.0%。 正确答案的比例几乎没有变化(78.5%对78.5%),额外费用约为1%。

blocks.en: Cheaper pairs also help. Gating GLM 5.3 Flash with pplx-decider gives fewer wrong citations than Gemini alone (12.8%), at about one-ninth of Gemini’s cost.
blocks.zh: 便宜配对也有帮助. Gating GLM 5.3 Flash 与双子座相比,

blocks.en: Which policy is best depends on how much worse a wrong citation is than an unnecessary review. If the two count the same ( k = 1 k=1 ), a decision model alone is nearly as good as anything else. d1-ultra makes about as many wrong citations as Gemini (19.5%) at 1/30 of the cost. If a wrong citation counts five times as much ( k = 5 k=5 ), a combined policy is best for every pair we tested. At k = 10 k=10 , the best policy for most pairs sends more than half of the items to review, and wrong citations fall to about 2% or less.
blocks.zh: 哪种政策最好取决于错误引用比不必要的审查还要糟糕得多。 如果两者计算相同(k = 1 k = 1),单一个决定模型几乎与其它任何事物一样好. d1-ltra以成本的1/30计算得出与双子座一样多的错误引用(19.5%). 如果错误的引用数是5倍(k = 5 k = 5),那么我们测试的每一对都最好采用综合政策。 在 k = 10 k = 10 时,大多数对子的最佳政策会发送超过一半的项目来审查,错误引用率会降到2%左右.

The curves show the veto policy as its threshold varies; diamonds show the agreement gate. Moving down a curve buys fewer wrong citations with more review.

blocks.en: 4.4. Contamination

Models know much of the case law but do not depend on it. The strongest models pick the right holding from the citation alone well above chance, yet anonymizing case names and citations costs only 0.5 to 5.7 points. Appendix C gives the full results.
blocks.zh: 模型知道许多判例法,但并不依赖于它。 最强的模型仅仅从引用中挑选出正确的观点,远远高于偶然性,但将案例名称和引用的匿名性只花费0.5至5.7点。 附 录 C给出了全部结果.

blocks.en: 4.5. Distillation

Table 3. Qwen3-8B on the abstain condition (all 5,314 test items) before fine-tuning, after fine-tuning on Jev’s probabilities alone, and after fine-tuning on gold labels. Each version was trained once on 10,000 training items.
blocks.zh: 表3. 精细调整前,仅对Jev的概率进行精细调整后,对金色标签进行精细调整后,对弃权条件(全部5,314个测试项目)的Quen3-8B. 每个版本都接受了1万个培训项目的培训。

blocks.en: This experiment asks whether a decision model’s probabilities can be used to train a model that a firm or court could run on its own hardware. We fine-tuned Qwen3-8B in two ways, once to match Jev’s probabilities and once on the gold labels, and compare both with the model before fine-tuning (Table 3 ). The first version never sees a gold label. All three are evaluated on the full abstain condition.
blocks.zh: 这一实验询问是否能够利用一个决定模型的概率来培训一个公司或法院可以自行运行的模型。 我们用两种方式对Quen3-8B进行了微调,一次与Jev的概率相匹配,一次在金色标签上,并在微调前与模型进行对比(表3). 第一版从未见过金色标签. 三者均按完全弃权条件进行评估。

blocks.en: Before fine-tuning, Qwen3-8B is not usable for this task. It answers none on most items, whether or not a correct holding is present, and its probabilities are far from calibrated (ECE 0.504).
blocks.zh: 在微调前,Qwen3-8B无法用于此任务. 无论是否存在正确的持有,大多数项目都没有答案,而且其概率远未校准(ECE 0.504)。

blocks.en: Trained only on Jev’s probabilities, Qwen3-8B behaves much like Jev. Its accuracy is 63.8%, against Jev’s 63.9%. It picks a wrong holding and abstains wrongly about as often as Jev, and its AUROC is 0.777, against Jev’s 0.784. Its calibration error falls to 0.025, which is lower than Jev’s own.
blocks.zh: Qune3-8B只接受过Jev概率训练, 其精度为63.8%,而Jev为63.9%。 它选择了错误的持有,错投了与Jev一样频繁的弃权,它的AUROC是0.777,与Jev的0.784相对. 它的校准误差降至0.025,低于Jev自己的.

blocks.en: Gold labels still give a more accurate model, at 74.9%. Most of that gain comes from abstaining less often when a correct holding is present (7.2% against 24.6%), and the gold-trained model picks a wrong holding more often (38.1%). Measured by accuracy, Jev’s probabilities close about two-thirds of the gap between the untrained model and the gold-trained one, without any labeled data.
blocks.zh: 黄金标签仍然给出了更准确的模型,为74.9%. 大部分收益来自在存在正确持有(7.2%对24.6%)时弃权次数较少,而黄金训练型更经常地选择错误持有(38.1%)。 根据准确性衡量,Jev的概率接近了未经过训练的模型与黄金训练的模型之间约三分之二的差距,没有任何标注数据.

blocks.en: 5. Discussion
blocks.zh: 5.五. 讨论情况

blocks.en: 5.1. Two Ways to Fail
blocks.zh: 5.1. 失败的两种方式

blocks.en: The two kinds of model fail in opposite directions. Most generative LLMs rarely abstain and often pick a wrong holding. Jev abstains often and picks a wrong holding least. We think this follows from how each is trained. Generative LLMs are tuned and graded on tasks where answering is rewarded and abstaining is not ( Kalai et al., 2025 ) , and more reasoning does not reliably help them abstain ( Kirichenko et al., 2025 ) . Decision models are trained to return probabilities that match outcomes. That gives a user something to act on. Their probability of none separates items with and without a correct holding (AUROC 0.73 to 0.89).
blocks.zh: 两种模型在相反的方向上失败. 大多数遗传性有限责任公司很少投弃权票,往往选择错误的持有。 Jev经常弃权 并且选择一个错误的持有最少。 我们认为,这是如何对每个人进行培训的结果。 (Kalai等人,2025年), 更多的推理并不能可靠地帮助他们弃权(Kirichenko等人,2025年)。 对决策模式进行了培训,以恢复与结果相符的概率。 这让用户有行动能力 它们的不设概率将物品与正确持有和没有正确持有分开(AUROC 0.73至0.89)。

blocks.en: We do not read this as a verdict for one kind of model. Jev’s caution means it abstains on about one in four items that do have a correct holding, and a decision model’s confidence is not always a reliable sign of missing knowledge ( Shankaranarayana et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 我们不认为这是对一种模式的判决。 Jev的谨慎意味着它投弃权票, 大约四分之一的项目确实有正确的持有,

blocks.en: 5.2. Accuracy Is the Wrong Scoreboard for Legal Authority
blocks.zh: 5.2. 准确性是法律权威的错误记分板

blocks.en: A wrong citation and an unnecessary review are not equal errors. The first can reach a filing and end in sanctions ( Noland, 2025 ; Whiting, 2026 ) . The second costs a lawyer the time it takes to look something up. Accuracy counts them the same, which is how a model that guesses can outscore one that abstains. Our earlier work made the same point for precedent treatment, where some misclassifications matter far more than others ( Demir and Canbaz, 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 错误的引用和不必要的审查并不等于错误。 第一种可以达到备案和结束制裁(Noland,2025;Whiting,2026). 第二次要花律师的时间去调查 准确性也算它们一样,这就是一个猜测的模型可以比投弃权票的模型高分的方式. 我们先前的工作对先例的处理提出了同样的观点,一些错误的分类比另一些重要得多(Demir和Canbaz,2025年)。

blocks.en: How much worse a wrong citation is depends on the user, the matter, and the court. A pro se litigant drafting a first motion and a firm filing an appellate brief do not face the same stakes. We therefore report the full trade-off rather than one score. Choosing an operating point is a decision about acceptable risk, and it belongs to the lawyer or firm using the tool, not to its vendor. That choice can only be made well if evaluations of legal AI tools report, next to accuracy, how often a tool cites an authority when none applies and how often it declines when one does.
blocks.zh: 错误的引用有多糟糕取决于用户,事项,以及法庭. 起草第一项动议的亲诉讼人和提交上诉书状的事务所面临的风险并不相同。 因此,我们报告完全取舍,而不是一分。 选择操作点是决定可接受的风险,属于使用该工具的律师或事务所,而不是其供应商。 只有当对AI法律工具的评价报告准确性之后,一个工具在不适用的情况下会在多大程度上引用权威,在适用时会如何下降,才能作出良好的选择。

blocks.en: 5.3. A Cheap Check, Not a Substitute
blocks.zh: 5.3. 廉价 检查, 不是替补

blocks.en: A decision model costs a small fraction of a generative LLM call, so it can be asked for a second opinion on every answer. Accepting a generative LLM’s answer only when a decision model agrees halved wrong citations in our test while keeping nearly all correct answers. This agrees with the observation that hard verification items tend to defeat some models but not others ( Demir and Canbaz, 2026 ) , so disagreement is informative.
blocks.zh: 一个决定模型花费了一个基因LLM调用量的一小部分,因此可以要求它就每一个答案提出第二个意见. 只有当一个决定模式同意在测试中将错误引用量减半,同时保留几乎所有正确答案时,才会接受基因LLM的答案。 这同意以下观点,即硬核查项目往往会击败一些型号,而不是其他型号(Demir and Canbaz, 2026),因此分歧是翔实的。

blocks.en: None of this removes the lawyer’s duty to read what they cite. Courts have been clear that every cited authority must be read and verified, whatever its source ( Noland, 2025 ) . What a combined system can do is point that reading at the answers most likely to be wrong.
blocks.zh: 这些都不能免除律师阅读其引述内容的义务。 法院已经明确,无论来自何方(Noland,2025年),每个被引用的权威都必须被读取和核实。 一个综合系统可以做的是指出最有可能错误的答案的读取.

blocks.en: Knowing the case law is also not the same as respecting what the passage supports. Shown only a case’s citation, with none of the surrounding passage, the strongest models still picked its holding in about three of four items, well above the one-in-five chance rate (Appendix C ). They have learned much of the case law itself. But legal authority depends on what a court actually held in the opinion at hand. In verification, prior knowledge can even override the provided text ( Demir and Canbaz, 2026 ) . Our abstain condition rewards a model only for recognizing that the holding in front of it is not the one the court relied on.
blocks.zh: 了解判例法也不同于尊重通过支持的内容。 仅显示一个案例的引文, 周围没有一条通道, 最强的模型仍然在大约四个项目中选择了三个, 他们了解了判例法本身的许多内容。 但是,法律权威取决于法院在目前的意见中实际持有什么。 在核查中,先前的知识甚至可以推翻所提供的文本(Demir和Canbaz,2026年)。 我们的弃权条件只奖励一种模式,因为它承认在它面前的持有不是法院所依赖的。

blocks.en: 5.4. Running the Check Locally
blocks.zh: 5.4. 在当地进行核对

blocks.en: Many firms cannot send client material to external services, which rules out hosted models for much of their work ( Demir et al., 2025 ) . The distillation result suggests one way forward. Trained on Jev’s probabilities alone, with no labeled data, a local Qwen3-8B model reproduced Jev’s accuracy and abstention behavior and became well calibrated, after 90 minutes of training on one workstation GPU. The teacher’s probabilities can be collected on public material, such as published opinions, and the student can then run on the firm’s own hardware. The student also inherits the teacher’s mistakes, so a firm should test it on its own work before relying on it.
blocks.zh: 许多公司不能向外部服务发送客户材料,因为外部服务排除了大部分工作的主机模型(Demir等人,2025年)。 蒸馏结果建议了一条前进的道路. 一个本地的Qwen3-8B型机型只接受了Jev的概率训练,没有标注数据,在经过一个工作站GPU的90分钟训练后,复制了Jev的精度和弃权行为,并变得精准校正. 教师的概率可以收集到公开的材料上,比如发表的意见,然后学生可以用公司自己的硬件运行. 学生也继承老师的错误,所以公司在依靠自己的工作之前,应该先进行测试.

blocks.en: 6. Limitations
blocks.zh: 6. 限制

blocks.en: Contamination. CaseHOLD is built from public opinions decided before 2021, and the training data of the closed models we test is not disclosed. Our perturbation checks show that models know much of the case law but do not depend on recognizing the case; they cannot rule out that the models saw these passages in training.
blocks.zh: 沾染诸法. CaseHOLD是根据2021年之前决定的舆论构建的,我们测试的封闭模型的培训数据不披露. 我们的扰动检查表明,模型了解许多判例法,但并不取决于是否承认案件;它们不能排除模型在培训中看到这些段落。

blocks.en: A constructed absence. In our abstain condition, the correct holding is replaced by a real holding from another case. In practice, authority goes missing in other ways as well: a case may have been overruled, may come from the wrong jurisdiction, or may simply not exist. Our condition measures one controlled form of absence, not all of them.
blocks.zh: 虚构的缺席。 在我们弃权的条件下,正确的持有被另一个案件的真正持有所取代。 在实践中,权威也在其他方面缺失:案件可能已被推翻,可能来自错误的司法管辖,或者根本不存在。 我们的病症衡量一种可控的缺席形式,而不是所有。

blocks.en: The cost of errors. The values of k k we report are illustrative. We know of no empirical estimate of how much worse a wrong citation is than an unnecessary review, and the right value will differ across practice settings.
blocks.zh: 错误的代价。 Kk我们报告的数值是说明性的。 我们知道,对于错误引用比不必要的审查更糟糕的程度,没有任何经验估计,而且正确价值将因实践环境而异。

blocks.en: Scope. We test one task, United States case law in English, and one prompt per kind of model. Generative LLMs may behave differently under other prompts, reasoning settings, or retrieval, and the models we test will change; our results describe versions available in October 2026. Each distillation configuration was trained once, on 10,000 items, so its results carry more uncertainty than those of the hosted models.
blocks.zh: 范围。 我们测试一项任务, 美国案例法的英语, 和每个类型的模型的快速。 Generative LLMs在其他提示,推理设置,或检索下可能表现不同,我们测试的模型将会改变;我们的结果描述了2026年10月可用的版本. 每个蒸馏配置都经过过一次培训,在1万件物品上,因此其结果比主机模型的不确定性更大.

blocks.en: 7. Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7. 结论

blocks.en: We asked what generative LLMs and System One decision models do when the authority a court relied on is not among the candidates. Most generative LLMs still pick a holding, some in more than four of five such cases, while the most cautious decision model does so in fewer than one in three, at a fraction of the cost. Neither kind of model is reliable on its own, but pairing them halves the wrong citations of the strongest generative LLM we tested, and a decision model’s probabilities can teach a local model to behave the same way without labeled data.
blocks.zh: 我们问,当法院所依赖的权力不在候选人之列时,世系有限责任公司和第一系统的裁决模式会做什么。 大多数遗传性有限责任公司仍然选择一种持有方式,有些在五种情况下有四种以上,而最谨慎的决定模式则在不到三分之一的情况下选择,费用只有一小部分。 这两种模型本身都不可靠,但将它们配对将我们测试的最强基因LLM的错误引号减半,而一个决定模型的概率可以教一个本地模型在没有标注数据的情况下以同样的方式行事。

blocks.en: What calibrated probabilities offer is not correctness but a dial: the user can decide how cautious the system should be. Lincoln’s advice to young lawyers was to be honest before anything else. For a research tool, honesty starts with saying when it cannot find the authority.
blocks.zh: 校准概率的提供不是正确,而是拨号:用户可以决定系统应多谨慎. 林肯对年轻律师的建议是,要先诚实地对待其他事情. 对于一个研究工具来说,诚实从无法找到权威时开始.

blocks.en: Appendix B Pilot Study and Additional Results
blocks.zh: 附录B 试点研究和额外结果

blocks.en: Before the main study, we ran 1,000 randomly chosen test items with GPT-6 Luna prompted to return an answer together with its confidence from 0 to 100. In the abstain condition, it picked a holding in 60% of the items without a correct one, and its stated confidence on those wrong picks averaged 0.91. Its expected calibration error was 0.29, against 0.07 and 0.08 for the two decision models run on the same items. Abstaining whenever its stated confidence fell below a high threshold (0.90) reduced its wrong picks to a level similar to a decision-model veto, but such a threshold has to be found on labeled data. Because generative LLMs do not state confidence in normal use, the main study asks them for an answer only.
blocks.zh: 在主研究之前,我们用GPT-6 Luna的动机,随机选择了1000个测试项目,促使它带着从0到100的置信度返回一个答案. 在弃权条件下,它选择了60%的项目持有,但没有正确的项目,它声明的对错误项目的信心平均为0.91。 其预计校准误差为0.29,而在同一项目上运行的两个决定模型分别为0.07和0.08。 如果其表示的信心低于高门槛(0.90),则弃权,将其错误选择降至类似于决定模式否决权的水平,但必须在贴有标签的数据中找到这种门槛。 由于遗传性LLMs并不表示对正常使用的信心,所以主要研究只要求它们给出答案.

blocks.en: We also fine-tuned the legal BERT model released with CaseHOLD ( Zheng et al., 2021 ) on the full training split (42,509 items), three seeds per setting. Trained on gold labels, it reached 75.7% on the original task and 61.3% on the abstain condition. Adding Jev’s probabilities to the training loss raised original-task accuracy by 0.7 points and halved its calibration error (0.043 to 0.022); on the abstain condition, it made the model abstain more often without improving accuracy. Because this encoder is already nearly as accurate as Jev on CaseHOLD, Jev has little to add. The larger gain for Qwen3-8B (Section 4 ) comes from a student that starts far below its teacher.
blocks.zh: 我们还对与CaseHOLD(郑等人,2021年)发布的关于全训练分(42,509项),每场3个种子的BERT模型进行了微调. 接受金牌培训后,原任务达到75.7%,弃权条件达到61.3%. 将Jev的概率加到训练损失上,使原任务精度提高了0.7分,并将其校准误差(0.043至0.022)减半;在弃权条件下,它使得模型在不提高精度的情况下更频繁地弃权. 由于这个编码器在CaseHOLD上已经几乎和Jev一样准确,Jev几乎没有可加的. Qune3-8B(第4节)的较大收益来自一个远低于教师的学生。

blocks.en: Appendix C Contamination Checks
blocks.zh: 附录C 污染 检查

blocks.en: CaseHOLD is built from public opinions that predate the models we test, so a model may recognize a cited case rather than reason from the passage. For closed models, whose training data is not disclosed, contamination cannot be measured directly ( Sainz et al., 2023 ) . We therefore use perturbation tests as a proxy. They cannot show whether a model saw the data, only whether its answers depend on recognizing the case.
blocks.zh: CaseHOLD是建于我们测试模型之前的舆论,因此一个模型可能承认一个引用的案例,而不是从段落中推理. 对于未披露培训数据的封闭模型,无法直接测量污染(Sainz等人,2023年)。 因此,我们使用扰动测试作为代用。 它们无法显示模型是否看到数据,只能显示其答案是否取决于对案件的识别.

blocks.en: Arvin (2025) introduced such a test for CaseHOLD. A language model rewrote each passage so that every case name and citation was replaced by a plausible fictitious one; GPT-4o’s macro F1 fell only from 0.744 to 0.728, and 88% of its answers were unchanged. We repeat this anonymization with GPT-6 Luna as the rewriter on a random sample of 500 test items, and we check each rewrite automatically. The cited case’s citation must be found where the holding was removed, and the rewritten passage must stay close to the original. We keep the 406 items that pass. Of the rest, 76 rewrites changed too much of the passage, and in 18 the citation could not be located. We add two variants on the same items: citation only , in which the model sees only the cited case’s citation, and citation removed , in which that citation is replaced by [citation omitted] . High accuracy from the citation alone means a model knows the case; accuracy that survives anonymization and citation removal means it does not depend on that knowledge.
blocks.zh: 阿文(2025)为CaseHOLD引入了这样的测试. 一个语言模型改写了每个段落,使每个案例的名称和引用被一个假冒的名称所取代;GPT-4o的宏F1从0.744降至0.728,88%的答案没有改变。 我们用GPT-6 Luna来重复这个匿名,作为500个测试项目的随机样本的重写,我们自动检查每个重写. 引用的案情引文必须放在解除扣留的地方,重写通道必须紧贴原物. 我们保存了406件通过的物品 其余的76个重写者修改过多,18个引用者无法找到. 我们在同一项目上增加了两个变体:仅引文,其中模型只看到所引案例的引文,并删除引文,其中引文改为[引文省略]。 单从引用中得出高精度,就意味着一个模型知道情况;在匿名化和引用删除中幸存的精度,意味着它不依赖于该知识.

blocks.zh: 表4. 对原状态下的406个测试项目的准确性(%),有真实的引文,有案例名称和引文被虚构的引文所取代,有引用的引文被删除,只有该引文被显示。 机会是20%。

blocks.en: Models know much of the case law, but they do not depend on it (Table 4 ). Shown only the citation of the cited case, the strongest models pick the right holding far above chance: 74.4% for Gemini 3.8 Flash and 71.2% for pplx-decider. Yet replacing every case name and citation with a fictitious one costs between 0.5 and 5.7 points, and removing the cited case’s citation costs between 0.5 and 5.2. The decision models lose the least under anonymization (0.5 to 2.2 points). The strong results of pplx-decider are therefore not an artifact of recognizing the case, and its knowledge of case law is shared by the strongest generative LLM.
blocks.zh: 模型知道判例法的许多内容,但并不取决于案例法(表4)。 仅显示引用引用的例,最强的模型选择右控远高于机会:74.4%为双子座3.8 Flash,71.2%为pplx-decide. 然而,将每个案件的名称和引用改为虚构的,费用在0.5至5.7点之间,并去除引用案件在0.5至5.2之间的引用费用。 决策模型在匿名化下损失最少(0.5至2.2分). 因此,pplx-decide的强效结果并不是承认这个案例的一件文物,它对于判例法的知识被最强的基因LLM所分享.

blocks.en: Appendix D Distillation Settings
blocks.zh: 附录D 蒸馏 设置

blocks.en: We fine-tuned Qwen3-8B with LoRA (rank 16, α = 32 \alpha=32 , dropout 0.05) on the attention and feed-forward projections, in bfloat16 with gradient checkpointing. Training used AdamW with a learning rate of 10 − 4 10^{-4} , a cosine schedule with 5% warmup, batch size 4 with 4 accumulation steps (effective batch 16), and one pass over 10,000 randomly sampled training items. The model saw the same instruction as the API models, with options lettered A–E, F for none, and thinking disabled. Passages were truncated to their last 600 tokens and each option to 160 tokens; one CaseHOLD holding exceeds 20,000 tokens. The Jev-trained model minimized the KL divergence from Jev’s probabilities to the model’s distribution over the option letters; the gold-trained model minimized cross-entropy against the correct option. Each run used one NVIDIA RTX A6000 (48 GB).
